name: UniFi Network Application
short: Controller for UniFi access points, switches and gateways.
description: UniFi Network Application (linuxserver.io image) with a MongoDB database. Manages and adopts UniFi devices. Devices reach the controller on the host ports 8080/tcp (inform), 3478/udp (STUN) and 10001/udp (discovery); set the host IP as the inform host in Settings > System > Advanced when devices are not on the same L2 network.

db_root_password.title: Database root password
db_root_password.description: Root password of the MongoDB database. Use letters and digits only.

db_password.title: Database user password
db_password.description: Password of the MongoDB user of the UniFi application. Use letters and digits only.
